brief: Tallies latency samples in an engine histogram and reads percentiles from it, such as the median and the 99th.
detail: Record samples in milliseconds, then ask for P50, P95, P99 or any Percentile. The histogram is bucketed: a percentile is answered as the upper bound of the bucket it falls in, so it is an approximation and never an interpolated value. Count and Sum are exact.
receiver:
o1 = new stzLatencyHistogram()
o1.Record(10)
o1.Record(20)
o1.Record(30)
o1.Record(40)
o1.Record(200)
